messages:
elaine: quick idea  prefer a compact right-side panel for creating API keys instead of the big modal. keeps users on the current page. mock in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/sidepanel-v1

 tom: agree about context. question: primary CTA should be \"Create and reveal\" or just \"Create\"? folks usually expect to see the secret immediately.

 maria: implementation note: panel is easy to wire up. must define keyboard focus order: open -> name input -> reveal button -> copy. allow an option to skip reveal.

 nick: accessibility nit: when revealing, use aria-live to announce \"API key revealed. Copy now; you will only see it once.\" do not auto-select for screen reader users. panel needs role=dialog and a focus trap.

 tom: copy suggestion: primary = \"Create and reveal\", secondary = \"Create (hide secret)\". and make empty state copy explicit about single-view. current copy implies keys are viewable later which is misleading.

 elaine: suggested inline warning under name: \"This key is shown only once  copy it now or store it securely.\" add a tiny info icon linked to docs.

 maria: backend detail: when reveal=false return a one-time download URL valid for 30s. API sketch: POST /api-keys {name,reveal:false} -> {id, oneTimeDownloadUrl}.

 nick: ensure one-time download link has rel=\"noopener\", an accessible label, and is keyboard-focusable. announce expiry in the UI.

 tom: UX placement: keep copy/download UI anchored in the panel rather than a toast so keyboard users can reach it reliably. toasts can vanish too fast.

 maria: responsive: panel ~420px on desktop; fallback to full-screen on small viewports but keep focus trap.

 nick: a11y checklist: role=dialog, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby with the single-view note, visible focus outlines, announce \"copied\" via aria-live on copy.

 elaine: empty state rewrite: \"No API keys yet  create one to get started. You will only see each key once.\" primary CTA: \"Create API key\". small \"How keys work\" link below.

 tom: revoke/rotate microcopy: show muted suggestion: \"If this key is used by traffic-critical routes, consider rotating to avoid downtime.\"

 maria: rotation flow: create replacement -> switch usages -> revoke old. UI should present a 3-step checklist with progress.

 nick: make checklist keyboard navigable and announce step changes. include a learn-more link.

 elaine: next steps: tom update Figma with panel + CTA variants, nick draft the a11y checklist, maria prototype keyboard flow and one-time download, i'll write final microcopy and run a 5-dev usability session.

 deploy-bot: figma update uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/sidepanel-v1 ":rocket:"
